&api-questions;
The ACP API manages agent configurations, connections and sessions for NetBeans clients of Agent Client Protocol agents.
Clients configure agents with AcpAgentDescriptor and AcpAgentManager, obtain connections through AcpConnectionManager, and use AcpConnection and AcpSessionListener to exchange prompts and session updates.
MCP integrations implement org.netbeans.modules.acp.spi.AcpMcpServerProvider and register it in the default Lookup. Providers supply server definitions to sessions and revoke issued bearer tokens when a connection closes. Tool providers for the built-in server use the separate acp.mcp.spi module.
Configure an agent, create a connection and session, register a session listener, and send prompts. Close the connection when it is no longer needed.
Register an AcpMcpServerProvider in Lookup so that its server definitions are supplied to compatible agent sessions.
Unit tests cover agent configuration, session models, MCP server discovery and terminal handling.
